description: This file defines an abstract class 'Stage' used in Apache Spark's scheduler component, representing a set of parallel tasks within a Spark job, including methods and properties for managing stage attempts, failures, and dependencies.

classes.name: Stage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a stage in Spark's scheduling, managing tasks, attempts, failures, and dependencies.

methods.name: getNextAttemptId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the next attempt of this stage.

methods.name: makeNewStageAttempt
methods.description: Creates a new attempt for this stage with specified number of partitions and task locality preferences.

methods.name: increaseAttemptIdOnFirstSkip
methods.description: Sets the attempt ID to 1 if it was 0, used when skipping attempts.

methods.name: latestInfo
methods.description: Returns the StageInfo object for the most recent attempt.

methods.name: findMissingPartitions
methods.description: Returns a sequence of partition IDs that are missing and need to be computed.

methods.name: clearFailures
methods.description: Clears the set of failed attempt IDs.

methods.name: markAsRollingBack
methods.description: Marks the latest attempt as rolling back by updating maxAttemptIdToIgnore.
